Attribute VB_Name = "SheetAddCollectionOracle"
Option Explicit
Public Function Probe(ByVal receiverKind As Long, ByVal mode As Long, ByVal inputPath As String) As Variant
    Dim book As Object, anchor As Object, added As Object
    Dim countValue As Variant, errorCode As Long, errorText As String
    Dim errorSource As String, names As String, i As Long, addedIndex As Long
    Set book = Workbooks.Open(inputPath, 0, True)
    Set anchor = book.Worksheets(1)
    Dim sheetSet As Object
    Select Case receiverKind
    Case 0: Set sheetSet = book.Worksheets
    Case 1: Set sheetSet = book.Sheets
    Case 2: Set sheetSet = book.Charts
    End Select
    book.Saved = True
    Select Case mode
    Case 1: countValue = 2
    Case 2: countValue = 1.5
    Case 3: countValue = 2.5
    Case 4: countValue = 2.1
    Case 5: countValue = 0
    Case 6: countValue = -1
    Case 7: countValue = Empty
    Case 8: countValue = Null
    Case 9: countValue = "2"
    Case 10: countValue = "bad"
    Case 11: countValue = Array(1)
    Case 12: countValue = True
    Case 14: countValue = CDate(2)
    Case 15: countValue = CVErr(2042)
    Case 16: Set countValue = Nothing
    Case 17: countValue = Array(2)
    Case 18: countValue = Array()
    Case 19: countValue = Array(Null)
    Case 20: countValue = Array(True)
    Case 21: countValue = False
    Case 22: countValue = -0.5
    Case 23: countValue = 0.5
    Case 24: countValue = "2.9"
    Case 25: countValue = " 2 "
    Case 26: countValue = "&H2"
    Case 27: countValue = "1,000"
    Case 28: countValue = Array(2, 1)
    Case 29: countValue = Array(Array(2))
    Case 30: countValue = 0.99
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    If mode = 0 Then
        Set added = sheetSet.Add(After:=anchor)
    ElseIf mode = 13 Then
        Set added = sheetSet.Add(Before:=anchor, After:=anchor)
    Else
        Set added = sheetSet.Add(After:=anchor, Count:=countValue)
    End If
    errorCode = Err.Number
    errorText = Err.Description
    errorSource = Err.Source
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    For i = 1 To book.Sheets.Count
        names = names & "|" & book.Sheets(i).Name
    Next i
    If Not added Is Nothing Then addedIndex = added.Index
    Probe = Array(errorCode, errorText, errorSource, TypeName(added), added Is Nothing, book.Sheets.Count, VarType(book.Sheets.Count), book.Saved, VarType(book.Saved), names, book.ActiveSheet.Index, addedIndex, VarType(countValue))
    book.Close False
End Function

Attribute VB_Name = "SelectedAddCountOracle"
Option Explicit
' Self-authored conformance probe, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Public Function Probe(ByVal mode As Long, ByVal binding As Long) As Variant
    Dim book As Workbook, group As Object, typedGroup As Sheets, added As Object
    Dim selectedBefore As Long, worksheetsBefore As Long, chartsBefore As Long
    Dim n As Long, i As Long, countValue As Variant, names As String
    Dim number As Long, description As String, source As String
    Set book = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    book.Worksheets.Add Count:=2
    For i = 1 To 3
        book.Worksheets(i).Name = "S" & CStr(i)
    Next i
    n = mode + 1
    If mode > 2 Then n = 2
    Select Case n
    Case 1: book.Worksheets(1).Select
    Case 2: book.Worksheets(Array("S1", "S2")).Select
    Case 3: book.Worksheets(Array("S1", "S2", "S3")).Select
    End Select
    selectedBefore = Application.ActiveWindow.SelectedSheets.Count
    worksheetsBefore = book.Worksheets.Count
    chartsBefore = book.Charts.Count
    Select Case binding
    Case 0, 3, 6: Set group = book.Worksheets
    Case 1, 4, 7: Set group = book.Sheets
    Case 2, 5: Set group = book.Charts
    End Select
    Set typedGroup = group
    Select Case mode
    Case 3: countValue = Empty
    Case 4: countValue = Null
    Case 5: countValue = 1
    End Select
    book.Saved = True
    On Error Resume Next
    If binding < 3 Then
        If mode < 3 Then
            Set added = typedGroup.Add
        Else
            Set added = typedGroup.Add(Count:=countValue)
        End If
    ElseIf binding < 6 Then
        If mode < 3 Then
            Set added = group.Add
        Else
            Set added = group.Add(Count:=countValue)
        End If
    Else
        If mode < 3 Then
            typedGroup.Add
        Else
            typedGroup.Add Count:=countValue
        End If
    End If
    number = Err.Number
    description = Err.Description
    source = Err.Source
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
    For i = 1 To book.Sheets.Count
        names = names & "|" & book.Sheets(i).Name
    Next i
    Probe = Array(number, description, source, selectedBefore, Application.ActiveWindow.SelectedSheets.Count, worksheetsBefore, book.Worksheets.Count, chartsBefore, book.Charts.Count, book.ActiveSheet.Index, TypeName(added), added Is Nothing, book.Saved, names)
    book.Close False
End Function
